title: System
description: The daemon's metrics as Prometheus holds them: its passes, the store and the sessions, the api's reads, and each step's facts.

panels.title: On disk, by part
panels.description: disk.bytes: what each part of the store holds, as the daemon's last sweep read it, stacked: the runs' worktrees (worktrees), their records and files (runs), the folder handed to the runtime (engine), the records the runtime's sessions left where their harness keeps them (sessions), the checks' output (checks), the series (series), and everything else under the store's root (other). The sessions' records are outside the store, perhaps on another file system than the free room beside this panel describes, and only those a task still names are counted: a run removed leaves its records on the disk and out of this part, and a session still at work is counted once it has ended. A file hardlinked from outside the store, as a worktree's packages are, is the other name's and counts nothing.

panels.title: On disk, by factory
panels.description: disk.bytes of the parts kept by run or by task, by the factory of each run the last pass answered, stacked: the worktrees, the runs' records and files, and, as the runtime says them by task, the engine's journals, bodies and session files and the sessions' records. A folder or a task of no run known is in no factory, and only in its part.

panels.title: Free on the store's disk
panels.description: disk.free and disk.size: the bytes free on the file system that holds the store, and its size. Under WSL this is the Linux virtual disk, which is far larger than what it may take: the real limit is the Windows drive that holds its file, which is not read here, and space freed inside returns to it only when that file is compacted.

panels.title: Names that did not read
panels.description: disk.unread: the names of each part the last sweep could not read, a folder gone or shut while it was walked. They are in no byte of the part: a part above zero here holds more than is drawn.

panels.title: On disk, by kind
panels.description: disk.bytes by kind: what each kind inside each part of the store holds, as the daemon's last sweep read it, stacked, the kinds of a part adding up to the part beside this panel. In the runs (runs): a step's handed pictures, by their image type (pictures), the other files it handed (handed), the agents frozen for a run (agents) and its inputs (inputs), the run records (records), a person's words and marks beside them (marks), and any other name (runs-other). In the worktrees (worktrees): the checkout (checkout) and what is under a node_modules (dependencies), a file hardlinked from outside counting nothing. In the folder handed to the runtime (engine), as the runtime says what each file is: a session's output (session-output), a check's output (check-output), the rest a session keeps (session-files), the journals (journals), the bodies (bodies), and what no task names, its feed among it (engine-other). The harness's own records of the sessions (harness-records); the checks' closeouts and output (checks), the series (series), and everything else under the store's root (other).

panels.title: Largest runs now
panels.description: The ten runs that hold the most over their worktrees and their records and files, as the daemon's sweeps of the last 30 minutes read them: each run's largest reading. A folder of no run known is under its own name.

defaults.noValue: no sweep in the last 30 minutes

panels.description: The requests counted into api.poll.reads.

panels.title: Step followings opened per minute
panels.description: The upstream followings of a step opened, counted into api.step.follows: one a step, shared by every page that follows it.

panels.title: Cost
panels.description: step.cost over the range: each step's settled sessions' cost.

targets.expr: sum by (factory, workflow, step, agent) (increase(step_cost_total{service_name="$service", factory=~"$factory", workflow=~"$workflow", step=~"$step", agent=~"$agent"}[$__range]))

panels.title: Input tokens
panels.description: step.tokens.input over the range.

targets.expr: sum by (factory, workflow, step, agent) (increase(step_tokens_input_total{service_name="$service", factory=~"$factory", workflow=~"$workflow", step=~"$step", agent=~"$agent"}[$__range]))

panels.title: Output tokens
panels.description: step.tokens.output over the range.

targets.expr: sum by (factory, workflow, step, agent) (increase(step_tokens_output_total{service_name="$service", factory=~"$factory", workflow=~"$workflow", step=~"$step", agent=~"$agent"}[$__range]))

panels.title: Session time, p50 and p95
panels.description: step.duration: a settled session's time.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.5, sum by (le, workflow, step) (increase(step_duration_bucket{service_name="$service", factory=~"$factory", workflow=~"$workflow", step=~"$step", agent=~"$agent"}[$__range])))
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, workflow, step) (increase(step_duration_bucket{service_name="$service", factory=~"$factory", workflow=~"$workflow", step=~"$step", agent=~"$agent"}[$__range])))

panels.title: Tries, by outcome
panels.description: step.tries: the sessions settled, by how they ended.

targets.expr: sum by (workflow, step, outcome) (increase(step_tries_total{service_name="$service", factory=~"$factory", workflow=~"$workflow", step=~"$step", agent=~"$agent"}[$__range]))

panels.title: Checks, by verdict
panels.description: step.checks: the checks settled, by verdict.

targets.expr: sum by (workflow, step, outcome) (increase(step_checks_total{service_name="$service", factory=~"$factory", workflow=~"$workflow", step=~"$step", agent=~"$agent"}[$__range]))

panels.title: Rounds, by outcome
panels.description: step.rounds: a loop's rounds granted or run out of.

targets.expr: sum by (workflow, step, outcome) (increase(step_rounds_total{service_name="$service", factory=~"$factory", workflow=~"$workflow", step=~"$step", agent=~"$agent"}[$__range]))

panels.title: Denied calls
panels.description: The step.denied spans over the range: each call a harness denied, counted once its attempt ended. By step, agent and tool; by call and for one run on Steps.

targets.query: {resource.service.name="$service" && name="step.denied" && span.factory=~"$factory" && span.workflow=~"$workflow" && span.step=~"$step" && span.agent=~"$agent"} | count_over_time() by (span.workflow, span.step, span.agent, span.tool)
